description: This file defines a recursive planning router for a deep research agent, including functions for building topological task groups, creating research plans, refining tasks, identifying dependencies, deduplicating tasks, deciding search strategies, executing tasks, and orchestrating deep research workflows.

methods.name: _build_topological_groups
methods.description: Builds groups of tasks that can run in parallel based on dependency levels using topological sort.

methods.name: _get_execution_levels
methods.description: Determines all execution levels of tasks, from leaf to parent, based on dependencies.

methods.name: create_research_plan
methods.description: Creates a recursive, dependency-aware research plan by decomposing a research question into subtasks, refining, deduplicating, and analyzing dependencies.

methods.name: refine_task
methods.description: Recursively refines a single research task into smaller, distinct subtasks.

methods.name: identify_dependencies
methods.description: Analyzes a list of tasks to determine dependency relationships between them.

methods.name: deduplicate_tasks
methods.description: Identifies and merges redundant or similar tasks to reduce duplication.

methods.name: decide_search_strategy
methods.description: Decides whether a parent task should synthesize from children or perform an external search based on dependency findings.

methods.name: _execute_task_smart
methods.description: Executes a task by routing to search or synthesis functions based on dependencies and strategy.

methods.name: execute_deep_research
methods.description: Orchestrates the entire deep research process: plan creation, task execution in topological order, and final report synthesis.
